question: spent 20 mins entering contacts and when i hit refresh EVERYTHING vanished?? what happened

articles.title: Why your changes disappear when you reload
articles.body:
This is a demonstration copy of Harbour CRM. It stores everything in your browser's memory only.

Reloading the page resets all contacts, companies, deals, custom fields and settings to the original sample data. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere.

answer: This is a demonstration copy of Harbour CRM. It stores everything in your browser's memory only, so reloading the page resets all contacts, companies, deals, custom fields and settings to the original sample data. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere, which means the contacts you entered can't be recovered. Avoid reloading the page while you're working in the demo.
